newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek police arrest woman in German bombing probe.
newsitem.headline: Greek police arrest woman in German bombing probe.

text.p: Greek police arrested a German woman in connection with the bombing of a West Berlin nightclub 10 years ago which killed three people and wounded 200 others, including many U.S. serviemen, police sources said on Saturday.

They said the woman, identified as Andrea Hasler (phonetic spelling), was arrested on Thursday night in Halkidiki near this northern port city. The arrest coincided with the arrest in Berlin of another German woman, suspected of planting the bomb.
The sources said Hasler, 31, was with her two-year-old son and a boyfriend when she was arrested at a hotel. She was arrested at the request of the German authorities.
They said she was taken to Diavata prison in Salonika and they expected extradition to move quickly because she faced no charges in Greece.
In Berlin, prosecutors said they had arrested a 37-year-old German woman, identified only as Verena C., and her Palestinian ex-husband, Ali C., on Thursday.

The United States blamed Libya for the attack on the "La Belle" disco in West Berlin in 1986 and responded by bombing the Arab state, killing at least 15 people, including an adopted 15- month-old daughter of leader Muammar Gaddafi and wounding more than 100.
